shortDescription: Copper output from Chilean state-run miner Codelco fell nearly 5% year-on-year in July to 112,800 metric tons, state copper commission Cochilco said on Thursday.BHP-controlled Escondida's production tumbled 22% to 89,400 tons while Collahuasi's output climbed 12% to 38,400 tons.

children: Copper output from Chilean state-run miner Codelco fell nearly 5% year-on-year in July to 112,800 metric tons, state copper commission Cochilco said on Thursday.
BHP-controlled Escondida's production tumbled 22% to 89,400 tons while Collahuasi's output climbed 12% to 38,400 tons.
